notes: Passive studio condenser microphone with a single physical connector: the 3-pin XLRM audio output, which also carries 48V phantom power (no separate power port — phantom power is delivered over the XLR output pins from the connected mixer/interface, so no dc-barrel/iec port applies). No grade applies (analog XLR audio is ungraded per the connector-grade rules). Not rack-mountable (handheld/stand-mounted studio mic, so rackUnits omitted). Confirmed consistently across the manufacturer spec sheet PDF (docs.audio-technica.com/us/at4040_submit.pdf), the official product page (audio-technica.com/en-us/at4040), and retailer/reference sources (B&H, ZenPro Audio) — all agree on 3-pin XLRM output, 100 ohm impedance, 48V DC/4.2mA phantom requirement. Do not confuse with the AT4040USB variant, which adds a USB-C port — this entry is for the standard analog AT4040 only.

ports.name: Output
ports.note: Integral 3-pin XLRM-type output connector; Lo-Z balanced, Pin 2 hot, Pin 1 ground. Requires 48V DC phantom power (4.2 mA typical) supplied via this same connector from a mixer/interface/phantom supply — no separate power inlet.
